info.description: One successful use of an invite code: which code, by whom, when, and on whose invitation. The record of how somebody got into a community, and it is meant to outlive everything it refers to — see the snapshot fields below.

community.description: The community that was joined. Held here as well as on the code, so the history of a community can be read even for a code that no longer exists — without it, a redemption is only reachable through its code and becomes unfindable the moment the code is removed.

inviteCode.description: The code that was redeemed, while it exists.

user.description: The account admitted by this redemption, while it exists.

redeemedAt.description: When it happened. Written explicitly rather than read off `createdAt`, which records when the row was stored and is free to change meaning.

codeValue.description: The code as a string, copied at the moment it was used. A snapshot, not a convenience: the three relations above are all breakable — a code can be deleted from the admin panel, and either account can delete itself — and a record of an admission that cannot say who admitted whom is no record at all.

issuedByUsername.description: Who created the code, copied at the moment it was used. Null only if the code carried no issuer.

redeemedByUsername.description: Who used the code, copied at the moment it was used.
